title: HELIX Terminology: Enrollment Status
description: Standard statuses for a student's registration in a course section. Used by the Enrollment resource 'enrollment_status' attribute.

codes.definition: Student has registered but the term has not started or census has not passed
Student is on a waitlist for the section
Student is confirmed enrolled (post-census or post-start)
Student dropped the course before the institution's drop deadline (typically no record on transcript)
Student withdrew after the drop deadline (typically a 'W' on transcript)
Student completed the course and received a final grade
Student received an incomplete grade with a deadline for completion
Student is attending the course without receiving credit or a grade
